findings.title: `.small-action` becomes a flex container but its children still rely on `float`
findings.body: `.small-action` is now `display: flex`, but its children still use floats. `.topic-avatar` has `float: left` and `button` has `float: right`; floats are ignored on flex items. The button used to sit at the right edge and now sits immediately after `.small-action-desc`, because `.small-action-desc` has no `flex: 1` and the button has no `margin-left: auto`. The trailing `clear: both` on the same rule is also meaningless for a flex container. The float declarations should be removed and the button should be pushed right with `margin-left: auto` or a flex-grow on the description.

findings.title: `align-items` mixin emits a non-existent `-ms-align-items` property and has trailing whitespace
findings.body: `-ms-align-items` is not a real property, so it just adds dead CSS. The legacy `-webkit-box-align` and `-ms-flex-align` properties also use different keywords (`start`/`end`) than the modern `flex-start`/`flex-end`. The mixin passes `$alignment` through unchanged, so any value other than `center` or `baseline` produces invalid declarations for the old syntaxes. Line 120 also has trailing whitespace after `-ms-flex-align: $alignment;`.

findings.title: Global `order` and `line-height` added to `.extra-info-wrapper`
findings.body: `@include order(2)` and `line-height: 1.5` are applied to `.extra-info-wrapper` globally, not scoped to the header. `order` only matters inside the header's flex `.contents`, which couples this rule to the header layout. `line-height: 1.5` is a visible change to every place the class is used. The removed `.bullet { margin-top: 5px }` compensation also now depends on `align-items: center` in the parent. Any context where this wrapper is not inside that flex container will misalign the bullet badge.
